config.mxtoolswapper.title: MX Tool Swapper
config.mxtoolswapper.elytraSwap.tooltip: Put an elytra from your inventory into the chest slot when pressing jump in mid-air, so you start gliding right away.
config.mxtoolswapper.elytraSwapBack.tool: After landing, put the previously worn chestplate back on. Only applies to an elytra that was equipped automatically.
config.mxtoolswapper.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. Can also be toggled with a key (Controls > MX Tool Swapper).
config.mxtoolswapper.toolSwapMode.toolti:
Any: swap to the best tool when mining, also away from a sword (only if Swap Weapon is on, so the sword comes back on the next attack).
Only Tools: don't swap while holding a sword.
No Swap: never swap tools when mining.
config.mxtoolswapper.swapWeapon.tooltip:
Swap to the strongest sword (or axe if there is no sword) when attacking an entity.
When off, a held sword is never swapped away while mining.
config.mxtoolswapper.swapFromAnyItem.too:
Also swap when holding a non-tool item or an empty hand.
By default, swapping only happens while a tool or sword is held.
config.mxtoolswapper.showToggleMessage.t: Show a message above the hotbar when toggling with the key.
config.mxtoolswapper.searchHotbar.toolti: Also use tools from the hotbar, not only from the main inventory.
config.mxtoolswapper.selectHotbarSlot.to: If the best tool is in the hotbar, select its slot instead of moving it into the current slot.
config.mxtoolswapper.minRemainingDurabil: Tools with this much durability left or less are not swapped in. 0 disables this.
config.mxtoolswapper.filterType.tooltip:
Allowlist: only listed items are swapped.
Blocklist: listed items are never swapped.
config.mxtoolswapper.filterItems.tooltip: Item ids like minecraft:diamond_pickaxe or item tags like #minecraft:axes.
config.mxtoolswapper.keepSuitableTool.to:
If the tool in your hand already mines the block properly, keep it instead of swapping to a faster one.
When off, the mod swaps to a faster tool, but never between a silk touch tool and one without.
config.mxtoolswapper.returnToPreviousToo: After the mod swapped your tool away (e.g. to a shovel for dirt), go back to exactly that tool when it fits again, instead of the fastest one.
config.mxtoolswapper.preferSilkTouch.too: Mine the blocks below with a silk touch tool if you have one, even if the held tool works. Afterwards the mod goes back to your previous tool.
config.mxtoolswapper.silkTouchBlocks.too: Block ids like minecraft:ender_chest, block tags like #minecraft:ice or ids with * as a wildcard like minecraft:*glass_pane.
